description_for_human: AI-powered job search: find jobs, check ATS resume score, generate tailored resumes and cover letters.
description_for_model: Hyred is an AI job-search platform. Use it to search for jobs by keyword/location, check how well a resume scores against ATS systems, generate tailored resumes for specific jobs, and write personalized cover letters. Jobs are sourced from LinkedIn, Indeed, Naukri, and 30+ ATS platforms.
